newsitem.title: UK: Central Transport launches finance inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Central Transport launches finance inquiry.

text.p: Central Transport Rental Group (CTR) said it had commissioned an inquiry into circumstances surrounding a 6.3 million stg recovery of value added tax over of a bad debt claim in the year ending April 30, 1994.
In a statement, the company said the investigation followed a recent enquiry from UK customs and excise.
It said the investigation would seek "to clarify whether or not the company has any liability to repay this amount with interest."
CTR added that if repayment was necessary, penalties might also be payable.
CTR is a trailer rental company.

It took an exceptional charge of 138.8 million stg in the year ending April 30, 1996 to cover restructurings, which helped bring it to a pretax loss of 181 million stg from 35.7 million stg previously.
